evidence.section: Effect of Annealing on Fracture of Ultrafine-Grained Alloy VT16
evidence.quote: The pores formed in ternary junctions and on boundaries of grains and had a round shape, which indicates substantial contribution of the diffusion mechanism into their development.
at 293 – 673 K the ultimate strength of VT16 in the ultrafine-grained condition is 40 – 20% higher than in the fine-grained one.
The strain before failure of the ultrafine- grained alloy at room temperature is about 2 times lower than in the fine-grained condition.
In the range of 832 – 973 K the strain before failure of the ultrafine- grained alloy increases from 320 to 690%
